title: Nonantum Capital Partners: 2026 Annual Meeting

voiceover.text: Welcome to the Nonantum Capital Partners annual meeting. Here's our update on the portfolio, year to date.
Since twenty eighteen, our partners have committed about one billion dollars across two funds, backing founder-owned businesses, corporate carve-outs, and complex situations.
Today that's twelve platform investments, across consumer, industrials, and business services.
Twenty twenty-six has been active. We welcomed Flatiron Search Partners in January, and RoadOne added Higgins Transport at the Port of Charleston.
Across the portfolio, revenue is up fourteen percent year to date, and EBITDA is up seventeen, with nine add-on acquisitions closed.
Fund One stands at two point one times invested capital, and Fund Two at one point four.
One standout: Lifted Trucks has sold more than six thousand four hundred trucks this year, up thirty-seven percent, and opened five new stores.
For the rest of the year, we're focused on add-ons, cash conversion, and preparing Fund One for realizations.
Thank you for your continued partnership.
